method: Public CLI subprocess wall clock including interpreter startup, validation, query and JSON output. First invocation is cold-process; repeats warm filesystem caches. Build has already touched the data; OS-cold disk latency is not claimed. Every invocation starts a new process.
budget_basis: 40 MiB rounds the measured approximately 34 MiB database upward; unchanged approximately 7.6 MiB reverse index fits 8 MiB. CLI regression ceiling is twice the largest measured sample on this environment, not a native UI latency commitment.
